research_goal: Measure client-observable bystander latency under state-triggered revocation when client and backend release semantics may diverge; identify mechanism boundaries on observable serving.

resources.backend_generation: Server-side generation / queue / KV; unknown on black-box API

G0.runtime_slot: hold until natural stream end after revoke; then release; then successor may dispatch
G0.api_stream: keep reading until natural end; discard outputs

G2-local.backend_generation: forced unknown on DS; never fill residual=0 from aclose

G2-residual.backend_generation: injected or observed residual hold D seconds

G2-hold-slot.runtime_slot: revoke eligibility but delay slot release to scheduled time

ds.prompt_template: Write a detailed inventory restocking plan in exactly {words} English words. Do not use tools.
ds.arrival_offsets_s_recipe: hash(seed, role, index) mapped into [0, 12] with target at 0; same seed shares offsets across arms
ds.pairing: interleaved same-seed G0/G2-local; random arm order recorded
ds.transport_failure: mark trace failed; primary P95 uses only paired traces where both arms succeed
ds.claim_ceiling: client-observable queue externality only; never infer server stop from aclose

timestamps.W_ttft: t_ttft - t_arrival (secondary; never mix with W_slot)

statistics.p95: linear interpolation on B=8 bystander samples within trace; rank (n-1)*0.95
statistics.pairing: same seed G0 vs G2-local difference

thresholds.zero_band_tau_rule: max(0.05, 0.02 * baseline_p95_s); freeze after dev; provisional_tau_s=0.05
thresholds.sign_separation: sign_tau(dW_slot) != sign_tau(dT_e2e) and at least one side outside zero band

M0.dU_client: observed focal client slot occupancy difference G0 - G2-local
M0.significant_residual: holdout mean residual bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 AND abs(mean residual) >= delta

go_nogo.ds_go: D1 or D2 crosses engineering threshold on frozen DS confirm cells; D3 never labels residual=0 from aclose
go_nogo.vllm_go: stable local/e2e separation or significant M0 residual; at least L2-a or L2-b observation consistent; holdout direction correct
go_nogo.total_go: requires vllm_go; ds_go alone is measurement contribution only

vllm_observation_levels.rule: never upgrade a/b claims to c
